stories.title: Iranian man barely survives bombing, but wants war to go on
stories.summary: An Iranian man who was buried under rubble in US Israel bombing campaign says he wants the war to go on, and destroy the regime.

stories.title: With plummeting support for immigration policies, Trump administration shifts approach
stories.summary: The Trump administration is shifting their public approach on immigration as Congressional Republicans push to fund ICE through the end of Trump's term.

stories.title: Life on the edge: why Indonesians living near volcanoes won't leave
stories.summary: Indonesia has more than 120 active volcanoes. On the island of Java, thousands live alongside Mount Merapi, constantly balancing risks -- and most say they won't leave.

stories.title: The White House is planning a big prayer event. Almost all the speakers are Christian
stories.summary: As the White House prepares for a prayer event tied to the nation's 250th anniversary, some question why the lineup is almost entirely Christian.

stories.title: The lasting power of the show 'Survivor'
stories.summary: Ahead of the Season 50 finale of the beloved CBS show, two time "Survivor" player Rob Cesternino talks to NPR's Emily Feng about what gives the reality competition show such lasting power.

stories.title: Understanding modern China through reporting on a hidden family history
stories.summary: While in China to cover President Trump's visit to meet with leader Xi Jinping, host of NPR and WBUR's Here & Now Scott Tong spent time learning about a difficult chapter in his family's history.
